children: Sunshine Biopharma entered into a placement agent agreement with Aegis Capital for a best efforts public offering of common and pre-funded units. The deal priced 10,509,082 common units at $0.55 and 400,000 pre-funded units at $0.54999, generating approximately $6 million in gross proceeds at closing on October 9, 2026. Each unit included two Series D warrants exercisable immediately at $0.66 for five years; all pre-funded warrants were exercised before closing. Aegis received a 7% placement fee and a 1% non-accountable expense allowance, plus reimbursed accountable expenses.
: Placement agent agreement for best efforts public equity offering
: Raise capital to fund operations and growth
